resources.string: These optional settings record a data-source configuration. They do not connect to a source, retrieve credentials, schedule refreshes or establish source rights.
Use an opaque secret:// reference with letters, digits, slash, underscore, colon, dot or hyphen. Do not enter a password, token or credential value.
Supply an exact whole number of minutes, at least 1.
Not supplied, false and true are distinct. This setting does not change whether the component itself is enabled and does not start a connector.
Enter a value or clear the supply option.
Enter an exact JSON whole number without grouping or locale separators.
This input exceeds the local editor limit.

Pending input is retained only within the local recovery limit. A supplied connector reference that does not match the opaque reference format is not retained after leaving this form. Recovering input does not confirm a save.
